title: A Language for the Blue Hour
author: Vesper Quintana
blurb: Vesper Marchetti, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
